The Move In Sync app needs to seriously rethink its rating system. It’s frustrating that users are only given options like 4 or 5 stars, with no way to rate 1, 2, or even 3. This completely undermines transparency and fairness. A rating system should reflect genuine user experience — both positive and negative.
